- Initial release of the tock-fpx skill (v1.0.0)
- Query Tock (exploretock.com) data via the fpx CLI without running the tock-mcp server.
- Supports listing metros, searching city restaurants, viewing venue calendars, and listing reservations through a signed-in browser tab.
- Read-only access; booking and canceling reservations are not supported.
- Requires the Transporter browser extension and setup of an fpx profile.
